description: Header file defining POSIX time ABI wrappers for the Starboard platform, including type definitions, struct declarations, macro constants, and function prototypes for time-related operations.

methods.name: clock_id_to_musl_clock_id
methods.description: Converts platform clock IDs to musl clock IDs.

methods.name: musl_clock_id_to_clock_id
methods.description: Converts musl clock IDs back to platform clock IDs.

methods.name: __abi_wrap_clock_gettime
methods.description: Wrapper function for clock_gettime using musl types.

methods.name: __abi_wrap_gettimeofday
methods.description: Wrapper function for gettimeofday using musl types.

methods.name: __abi_wrap_time
methods.description: Wrapper function for time() using musl types.

methods.name: __abi_wrap_gmtime_r
methods.description: Wrapper function for gmtime_r using musl types.
